LimitsCategoryList.description: LimitsCategoryList declares the category names that item types may use in their Central Economy filters.

category.description: Categories are category identifiers accepted by the economy's item definitions.

LimitsDefinitionFile.description: LimitsDefinitionFile declares the category, tag, usage, and value names referenced by Central Economy item filters.

categories.description: Categories defines the item categories recognized by the economy.

lists.description: XMLName identifies the required `<lists>` document root.

tags.description: Tags defines the item tags recognized by the economy.

usageflags.description: UsageFlags defines location-purpose flags used to filter spawn locations.

valueflags.description: ValueFlags defines loot-tier flags used to filter spawn locations.

LimitsTagList.description: LimitsTagList declares the tag names that item types may use in their Central Economy filters.

tag.description: Tags are tag identifiers accepted by the economy's item definitions.

LimitsUsageList.description: LimitsUsageList declares location-purpose flags used to restrict where an item type can spawn.

usage.description: Usages are identifiers assigned to map areas and referenced by item spawn filters.

LimitsValueList.description: LimitsValueList declares loot-tier flags used to restrict item spawning by map region or economy value.

value.description: Values are tier or value identifiers referenced by item spawn filters.

NamedRef.description: NamedRef stores the name attribute used by CE reference elements such as usage, category, tag, value, type, and group.

name.description: Name is the identifier referenced by the containing CE element.
